description: Integration test that runs the app's real live path in Node: RecordingController -> ProviderCoordinator -> LocalLiveSpeechProvider -> LocalEngines -> the real audio/asr worker handlers with real pinned models, fed a WAV as 100 ms frames, with GlassesController on a fake bridge so assertions are on what the glasses would show. Only the worker transport, Cache Storage and the Even bridge are shimmed. Used to diagnose 'no captions on glasses' from a saved simulator recording and to verify fixes (9ij.16, 9ij.17).

comments.text: WIP in jj revision vynvuqzk (workspace live-harness, on xttmqlzt). Findings so far: (1) Node harness with real app code: warm models -> glasses captions at 2.3s on jfk; cold (old code) -> first caption 7.1s and utterances that end while Moonshine loads are never captioned. (2) WebKitGTK 2.52.6 (simulator engine), measured via app engines: Moonshine Base load 34.6s, CAM++ 3.8s, streaming Silero VAD RTF 2.1 (8.6s for 4s audio) -> live VAD can't keep up; per-call ORT overhead in JSC suspected (asyncify build). (3) Saved-audio Opus round trip in WebKitGTK produces muffled/low-passed audio that Whisper/Moonshine/Silero can't use (exported WAV of rec_d62 unusable) - separate bug.

Landed as vynvuqzk: pnpm test:live runs apps/even-hub/test/glasses-captions.live.test.ts and packages/provider-local/test/engines.live.test.ts with real models (cached in ~/.cache/irl-subtitles-models or IRL_MODEL_CACHE). Limits: Node's V8 WASM is much faster than WebKitGTK/JSC, so use asrLoadDelayMs to model slow loads; worker transport, Cache Storage and bridge are shimmed.
Follow-up: JSC-shell benchmark shows the asyncify ORT build is the big load/first-inference cost in WebKit (irl-subt-kdl, kdl.2); the remaining web-process slowdown is kdl.6.

title: Node live-pipeline harness: real app code and models on a WAV
